sections.heading: Writing
sections.body: I wanted to know why LLMs follow some instructions all session but forget others within a few turns. So I ran an experiment: 244 cases of an instruction being obeyed or ignored, fit with a Bayesian ordered logistic model. Some instruction types got followed about 10x more reliably than others.

sections.heading: Thinking about
sections.body: AI safety, effective altruism, and how to convince people to live a cognitively active life. If you want help disconnecting from social media and building more robust cognitive habits, chat with me!
